description: All tunable values for this airport. tailwindDryKt is researched specifically for this airport (see docs/EGCC_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md); trafficBands is an unresearched placeholder (see its own entry below); the rest are carried over unchanged from the other packs, not yet confirmed against the UK AIP.

tailwindDryKt.description: Maximum tailwind on a dry runway. Doubly supported: this is both the project-wide default used by every pack without its own research AND VATSIM UK's vMATS GEN 5.1 own stated preference threshold ('Runways 23L and 23R are preferred when the tailwind component is 5 knots or less and the runway surface conditions are dry') -- a genuine match, not a blind carryover.

tailwindWetKt.description: Maximum tailwind on a wet runway. Carried over; not confirmed against the UK AIP.

defaultCrosswindKt.description: Crosswind limit used only for a mode with no maxCrosswindKt of its own. Carried over; not confirmed against the UK AIP. Since 05L/23R and 05R/23L are parallel runway pairs, crosswind is identical regardless of which runway in a pair is active, so this is a general safety ceiling, not an EGCC-specific crosswind-based runway-choice input (owner's clarification this session) -- runway choice here is driven by tailwind (see tailwindDryKt) and the night rule, not by crosswind.

limitToleranceKt.description: A component passes if it is at most the limit plus this tolerance, so floating-point noise cannot fail a 0 kt limit.

calmWindKt.description: Wind (including variable wind) at or below this counts as calm: no tailwind and no crosswind.

nearLimitMarginKt.description: A tailwind or crosswind above zero and within this many knots of its limit makes the cell MARGINAL.

wetRunwayProbabilityPct.description: A PROB group (not on a TEMPO or INTER) with rain at or above this makes a slot WET.

dryingTimeMinutes.description: After the last WET slot the runway stays WET this long, then DRY.

precipitationCodes.description: Present-weather codes that count as precipitation.

metarValidityMinutes.description: The latest METAR decides the status of slots starting within this many minutes of its observation; after that the TAF governs.

lowVisibilityMetres.description: Visibility below this many metres is shown as a low-visibility event in the timeline. Display only; it does not change any mode.

forecastWindowMinutes.description: Default forecast window in minutes. Carried over from the other packs.

demandHorizonMinutes.description: Longest look-ahead for the traffic estimate; beyond it demand is unknown.

assumedDepartureWindowMinutes.description: Aircraft on the ground elsewhere and bound here are assumed to take off spread evenly over this many minutes.

assumedGroundSpeedKt.description: Assumed average ground speed for the flight time of aircraft not yet airborne.

trafficBands.description: Movements per 30 minutes, separately for arrivals and departures; the slot takes the higher level. UNRESEARCHED PLACEHOLDER, not a confirmed figure -- docs/NEW_AIRPORT_QUESTIONS.md says this is the one number that genuinely needs airport-specific research, and no declared-capacity source (the equivalent of LSZH's Swiss Slot Coordination figure) was found for EGCC this session. This carries over NFFN/YBTL's generic default bands rather than inventing a bespoke figure from the MAG pack's 2024 daily average of 537 movements (~22/hour), which is an airport-wide whole-day figure, not a declared per-30-minute runway capacity, and would be a worse basis for a 'researched' number than it looks. Needs a real source (NATS, Manchester Airport's own ACL/slot coordinator figures, or the UK AIP) before this is treated as confirmed.

preferenceDefaultPenalty.description: Preference score for a mode that has no row in a time band.

marginalPenalty.description: Score added for each MARGINAL slot in a plan.

changePenaltyLight.description: Score for changing mode in a slot with light traffic.

changePenaltyMedium.description: Score for changing mode in a slot with medium traffic.

changePenaltyBusy.description: Score for changing mode in a slot with busy traffic.

unknownDemandChangePenalty.description: Score for changing mode in a slot where traffic is unknown.

noModePenalty.description: Score per slot in which no mode is allowed, so a plan can always be produced.

minimumStayMinutes.description: A mode should be held at least this long once entered; a shorter stay costs shortStayPenalty.

shortStayPenalty.description: Score for each stay in a mode shorter than minimumStayMinutes.

changeoverPreparationMinutes.description: Warning time shown before a planned change.

metarStaleMinutes.description: METAR older than this is flagged stale.

tafStaleMinutes.description: TAF older than this is flagged stale.

vatsimStaleMinutes.description: Traffic data older than this is flagged stale.

currentModeStaleMinutes.description: A current mode set longer ago than this is flagged amber as possibly out of date.

auditMaxEntries.description: Audit trail size cap; oldest entries drop first.
